'''February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (17 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Warmasters, Pleasanton, California on 17 February 2001. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1739">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ pleasanton-ca-2-17-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 18 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Warmasters, Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 22
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Round 3, Alfred Dong v Michael Mendoza: Dong's report says he won by 17; Mendoza's report says he lost by 14.<ref name="tr-d1759" />
* Round 3, Alfred Dong v Michael Mendoza: Dong's report says he won by 17; Mendoza's report says he lost by 14.<ref name="tr-d1762" />
